digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend protocol and adapter seam
propositions: Core modules (applier, fetcher, apply_handlers, _attestation) must not import from adapters.jira or acli_subprocess at any nesting depth, including lazy/function-level imports.
Backend Protocol must expose scalar, read-only members: project (with DIG default), query_project (un-defaulted), and assert_env_ready() raising BackendEnvError.
JiraBackend must implement the new Backend protocol members by delegating to resolve_jira_settings, preserving current fail-fast and fail-closed semantics.
A neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError exception must be defined in _backend.py; JiraBackend's acli_subprocess.AssigneeNotFoundError subclasses it; apply_handlers catches the neutral base.
Full-tree AST walker using ast.walk must verify the four target modules contain no adapters.jira imports at any depth, replacing the top-level-only check.
ADR 0035 section (d) interface table must document the new scalar protocol members and both neutral exceptions for future backend implementors.
